'''Avrindar''' is a character who is mentioned in {{SA}}.

==History==
===Background===
Little is known about him, except that he is {{WP|Sri Lanka}}n, and that he and [[James Pedeaston (3D Universe)|James Pedeaston]] once had a (possibly sexual) relationship. It is implied that he was underage at the time of their relationship. Pedeaston talks fondly about their relationship on his radio program, ''[[The Wild Traveler]]'' on [[West Coast Talk Radio (3D Universe)|West Coast Talk Radio]].

===James Pedeaston's Travel Log===
During the final segment of The Wild Traveler, Pedeaston decides to read his travel log about elephants while waiting for callers. He accidentally read several pages about his time in Sri Lanka with Avrindar, after some of the pages in his journal were stolen by his show's producers team. According to Pedeaston, this is not the first time this happens, and some of his producers have previously threatened to send his journal to the [[Federal Bureau of Investigation|FBI]].
{{Quote|[...] Okay, maybe I should read the travel log again. This is from my diary in Sri Lanka: "For a few rupees a day, I have employed the services of a young man who has been my guide in pleasure as well as travel. There is something very exotic about him — Avrindar. He could be a boy, but like many locals, in certain lights he looks just like a little girl. He is a real minx who knows exactly what he's doing to it-... " Oh, wrong page. Here we are. "Avrindar took me deep into jungle, and there we took part in an ancient rite of passage for adolescents on the cusp of adulthood. We hunted each other in game very similar to the ancient games of kiss-chase I used to play-..." NO! WRONG PAGE! "Avrindar has left me; I'm broken. I thought I meant something, but it seems he would rather become a fisherman than follow me in an exotic life of degeneracy and narcotics as my houseboy. I hate myself. Why does this keep happening to me?" HELL! WRONG BIT AGAIN!!! Where's the page about watching the elephants mate, and it being really disturbing and making me slightly jealous? For both parties?
